title: 8 group costumes that work on a boat
caption:
Halloween's on a Saturday this year 🎃🚤 Which one is your crew? Comment the number.

#houstonhalloween #groupcostume #htx #clearlake

slides.headline: 8 group costumes that actually work on a boat
slides.body: Comment the number your crew is doing.

slides.headline: Astronauts.
slides.body: The dock is literally on NASA Parkway. Houston, we have a party.

slides.headline: Pirates. We had to.
slides.body: Eye patch optional. Cooler is the treasure chest.

slides.headline: Top Gun flight crew.
slides.body: Aviators, name tags, and one person who will not stop saying Maverick.

slides.headline: Pink Ladies.
slides.body: Matching jackets hold up great in the breeze.

slides.headline: Ghostbusters.
slides.body: Whoever carries the cooler gets to be the proton pack.

slides.headline: The Scooby gang.
slides.body: Somebody has to be Scooby. Pick early.

slides.headline: Spice Girls.
slides.body: Five roles, zero arguments. Okay, some arguments.

slides.headline: Parrotheads.
slides.body: Hawaiian shirts, Margaritaville rules, and a playlist that writes itself.

slides.headline: Boat rules for costumes.
slides.body: Flat shoes, eyes uncovered, nothing that drags on the deck. Send this to the group chat. @houstonpedalbarge
